theme: An open Monday, girls back home
greeting: The calendar's empty today, Dan — no meetings, no handoffs, just an open Monday with the girls back in the house. The one thing worth spending the runway on is the holiday bookings that have slipped past due.

needsAttention.title: The Maine Christmas SUV is still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: This is your only p1 on the board and it's been open since mid-September. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week sells out early — a refundable hold now costs nothing and takes the whole risk off the table.

needsAttention.title: December break has no destination yet
needsAttention.detail: All four girls, Dec 13–Jan 2. The decide-by (Sep 30) and book-by (Oct 15) dates have both passed, and holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year — pick domestic or international and book refundable.

flagged.title: An Independent Managers Club call is forming
flagged.detail: Mike is lining up a first conversation with the Tokyo group for the week of Nov 2; you're only cc'd and nothing's owed from you yet.

flagged.title: Laurence sent you his memoir pages
flagged.detail: A warm personal note with writing samples 'to get you started' — already read, no deadline, worth a reply when you have a moment.

inbox.noise: A dozen LinkedIn job alerts and retail promos landed overnight — nothing in them needs you.
inbox.clear: Your primary inbox is otherwise quiet; nothing is awaiting a reply.
